characters: Little Star: a very small, round, glowing star with a gentle smiling face.
Big Star and Moon: large, kind and calm.
Traveller: a woman carrying a bundle on her head, walking home along a path at night.

narrationPlan.voice: Soft, soothing lullaby-style storyteller (en-GH or en-GB). Slightly deeper voice for the Moon.
narrationPlan.pace: Very slow (about 90 words per minute); designed to be a bedtime read.
notes: The "Shine, shine, shine" chant is a repeated refrain: keep the rhythm identical each time.
Final page should fade into a whisper.

music: Optional gentle music-box lullaby (original composition or properly licensed). Ducks under narration. Not created.
culturalNotes: The story is universal and sets no specific culture. A Ghanaian version (traveller, setting, names) could be offered later as a localised variant.
reviewQuestions: Should the traveller and path be made explicitly Ghanaian (a village path)?
Is "peeping" a known word for this age or should it be "shining"?

pages.brief: Deep indigo sky, many stars, one small golden star with a face in the centre.
pages.narration: Slow, hushed, lullaby-like. Elongate "very, very small".

pages.brief: Little star glowing next to huge bright stars that look almost like suns.
pages.narration: A gentle chant on "shine, shine, shine".

pages.brief: Little star with downcast expression, softer glow.
pages.narration: Soft and sad, but not heavy.

pages.brief: Gentle crescent moon with a kind face, little star looking up to it.
Dark path through gentle hills, a woman with a bundle on her head walking, cloud covering most stars.
pages.narration: Quiet, a little tense but safe. Slow, whispering.

pages.brief: A single gap in the clouds with the little star shining, the traveller looking up in hope.
A soft pool of starlight on the path, footsteps leading along it.
pages.narration: Count steps slowly. The "shine" chant returns, more confident.

pages.brief: Warm lit doorway, the traveller waving at the sky, little star glowing happily.
pages.narration: Whisper. Slow right down, like falling asleep. Long pause before "The end".
